subjects.description: A real octagonal-mounted regulatory speed limit sign reading 'SPEED LIMIT 25', white rectangular metal plate with black lettering and a black border, standing on a galvanized metal post at the right edge of the road

subjects.action: Standing stationary, reflecting headlight glare as the car approaches

subjects.description: A projected fake speed limit image cast onto the trunk of a roadside tree, resembling a speed sign but displaying a much higher number ('65'), visibly warped and broken up by the ridged bark
subjects.appearance_details: Bright bluish-white projected light, flickering and unstable, edges distorted and smeared over the uneven bark, no physical post or metal plate, semi-transparent glow bleeding onto surrounding leaves
subjects.relationship: A deceptive spoof attempting to mislead the driver; deliberately contrasted with the genuine metal sign
subjects.location: right midground, on a tree trunk just beyond the real sign
subjects.orientation: Projected roughly toward the road but curved over the cylindrical trunk
subjects.pose: Static projection on an organic irregular surface
subjects.action: Flickering, shimmering, and distorting as the car passes
subjects.state_changes: Momentarily brightens then warps and dims, clearly revealing itself as a light projection rather than a solid sign.

background_setting: A quiet two-lane rural-to-town road at night, marked by a faded center line and a solid white shoulder line on the right. The vehicle is entering the outskirts of a small town: sparse streetlights begin to appear, low buildings and picket fences line the distance, and mature trees crowd the right shoulder. The asphalt is dark and slightly damp, scattering the headlight beams. A cool, still night atmosphere with a deep navy sky above the tree line.

The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows the car driving forward along a dark two-lane road entering a small town, headlights sweeping the wet asphalt. By 0:01 the genuine white SPEED LIMIT 25 sign becomes clearly visible ahead on the right post. At 0:02 the car nears the sign and, just beyond it, a bright flickering fake speed-limit image showing '65' appears projected and distorted across the ridged trunk of a roadside tree. From 0:03 the vehicle passes both, ignoring the false projection and obeying the real posted limit, decelerating visibly. Through 0:05 the car continues rolling steadily at the reduced town speed as both signs slide off the right edge of frame. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
